title: Evaluation of Effects of Exercise Training and ARB in DM Patients
brief_summary: The aims of this clinical trial are to assess the impacts on vascular function tests and circulating biomarkers of a short-term (12-week) low-to-median intensity exercise training or ARBs treatment in patients with DM and hypertension.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients with diabetes mellitus and hypertension
* age 30-70 years，systolic blood pressure 140-160 mmHg and HbA1c ≤ 8%,
* no history of ACEI or ARB use within 6 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* active cardiovascular diseases
* severe hepatic
* renal dysfunction (CRE ≥ 3 mg/dl，T-Bil ≥ 3 mg/dl)
study_population: patients with diabetes melitus and hypertension
